▌REAL GUEST EXPERIENCES

❝ The house was absolutely beautiful and such a great space for us to enjoy Scottsdale! My family had a wonderful time just enjoying time at the house, very comfortable beds and layout with lots of space to enjoy visiting. The few times we had questions about the property, the hosts were very quick to respond and helpful with any questions we had. Will absolutely be booking again when we come back to Arizona.❞

❝ We had a wonderful visit! The house was amazing! The house was very comfortable and clean. The Pool and backyard was perfect - we spent most of our time back there lounging around. Communication was super easy and fast. We will definitely be back!❞

❝ This was a perfect home for our family from two states to enjoy their spring break together. Our grandkids loved the pool with the slide, the putting green outside, and the game room inside. We had 11 people, so everyone had their own room/bed and the 4 bathrooms were perfect. The showers had great water pressure and shampoo/condtioner being provided was a nice extra. We all enjoyed watching the large TVs indoors & outdoors while cheering for our favorite teams. The home is in a beautiful community where we could take walks admiring homes and landscaping. We were impressed with our host managers from Premier Destinations who were easy to reach and quick to respond to any need or question we had.❞
— Karin, Mar 2026

❝ Ashley was so warm and welcoming! She greeted us with a smile and showed us the lovely home! Also, the food, wine and waters was an amazing gift! Super fun stay with the family! Thank you ❞
— Britt, Nov 2025
